n01.title: Laurel Marquise Necklace
n01.descriptionHtml:
Leaves of light around the neck. Clear marquise cut cubic zirconia, about 5 x 10mm each, are set on a slant in groups of three like leaves on a stem, each stone in its own four claw gold tone setting, and each cluster linked to the next.

STYLING TIP: Wear it alone with an open neckline, or with small studs.

Details

  • Stones: Marquise cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 5 x 10mm, in four claw settings
  • Pattern: Clusters of three stones set on a slant, linked one to the next
  • Width: Approximately 9mm
  • Length: Approximately 42cm (to confirm)
  • Metal: Gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

n02.title: Soleil Petal Pendant
n02.descriptionHtml:
A small sun at the throat. One round clear cubic zirconia of about 7mm sits up in six claws at the centre, and six slender polished gold tone petals curve out around it like a pinwheel, about 25mm across in all, on a fine snake chain.

STYLING TIP: Let it sit alone on a plain neckline, so the petals catch the light.

Details

  • Pendant: Approximately 25mm across, six polished petals
  • Stone: Round clear cubic zirconia, approximately 7mm, in a six claw setting
  • Chain: Fine snake chain with a lobster clasp and extender
  • Length: Approximately 42cm plus the extender (to confirm)
  • Metal: Gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

n03.title: Pearl Crescent Pendant
n03.descriptionHtml:
A pearl held by a new moon. One round white shell pearl of about 10mm sits in a small gold tone cup, with a slim crescent of small clear cubic zirconia curving around one side of it, on a fine box chain with a sliding bead.

STYLING TIP: Slide the bead to wear it high at the collarbone or lower on a V neck.

Details

  • Pearl: Round white shell pearl, approximately 10mm
  • Pearl source: Shell pearl, provenance not stated by the supplier
  • Stones: Small round clear cubic zirconia, approximately 2mm, in a crescent
  • Chain: Fine box chain with an adjustable sliding bead
  • Metal: Gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

n04.title: Molten Solitaire Pendant

  • Chain: Fine cable chain
  • Length: Approximately 45cm (to confirm)
  • Metal: Gold tone

  • Chain: Fine cable chain

n06.title: Petite Fleur Y Necklace
n06.descriptionHtml:
A tiny flower and a fine drop. Five small round clear cubic zirconia form a flower about 6mm across where the chain meets at the front, and a single fine chain falls about 5cm below it, ending in a small polished gold tone flower.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with a deep V or an open collar, so the drop runs straight.

Details

  • Flower: Approximately 6mm, five small round clear cubic zirconia around a gold tone centre
  • Drop: Fine chain, approximately 5cm, with a small gold tone flower charm
  • Chain: Fine cable chain
  • Length: Approximately 42cm (to confirm)
  • Metal: Gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

n07.descriptionHtml:

  • Chain: Fine curb chain with a lobster clasp and extender
  • Length: Approximately 42cm plus the extender (to confirm)
  • Metal: Gold tone

n09.title: Petite Heart Trio Necklace
n09.descriptionHtml:
A gold heart and three small lights. A polished puffed gold tone heart of about 7mm sits beside a tiny triangle of three round clear cubic zirconia, side by side along a fine cable chain.

Details

  • Chain: Fine cable chain with a lobster clasp and extender
  • Length: Approximately 42cm plus the extender (to confirm)
